field_docs.supported_efforts: Effort values to show in an effort selector, in DESCENDING order (highest first). 'xhigh' is the top tier and is sent verbatim as reasoning.effort. null = no discrete selector, but the gateway accepts effort values. Field omitted = model exposes no effort selection. Does not include 'none' — disabling is governed by `mandatory`/`default_enabled`.
field_docs.default_effort: Effort to pre-select when reasoning is enabled; maps to reasoning.effort. null when the provider has no effort selection.
field_docs.default_enabled: Default on/off state when the user has not set reasoning.enabled.
field_docs.supports_max_tokens: When true, the provider reasons by token budget: show a token-budget control and send reasoning.max_tokens (alongside or instead of reasoning.effort). false when reasoning is effort/level only.
field_docs.max_budget: Maximum thinking-token budget (only present when supports_max_tokens is true). When the user picks an effort instead of an explicit budget, send reasoning.max_tokens = clamp(floor(max_budget * effort_budget_ratios[effort]), budget_clamp.min, budget_clamp.max).
field_docs.mandatory: When true, reasoning cannot be disabled — hide disable controls and never send effort 'none' / enabled:false.
